# PC Remote Sentinel - Multi-PC Remote Management and Surveillance System

> Secure, cross-network multi-PC remote management, surveillance, and automation system controlled entirely through a single Telegram Bot for Windows 10 and 11.

## Project Overview
- **Name:** PC Remote Sentinel (Fleet Commander)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Mazonia/pc-controller-bot
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+
- **Supported OS:** Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **Control Interface:** Telegram Bot (mobile, desktop, and web clients)

## Architecture & Core Technologies
- **Telegram Bot Engine:** `python-telegram-bot` v21+ with long-polling and asynchronous task queues.
- **Vision & Capture:** OpenCV (`cv2`) for real-time webcam surveillance snapshots and screen video recording.
- **Input Automation:** `pyautogui` for mouse cursor manipulation, click simulations, hotkey triggers, and direct keyboard typing.
- **Diagnostics & Process Management:** `psutil` and `wmi` for CPU, RAM, disk, battery health metrics, and process termination.
- **Speech Synthesis:** `pyttsx3` for remote text-to-speech audio broadcast through PC speakers.
- **Network Resilience:** Outbound-only HTTPS long-polling and optional MQTT over TLS (AES-256-GCM) punching through Carrier-Grade NAT (CGNAT) and corporate firewalls with zero port-forwarding.

## Key Capabilities
- **Fleet Commander (`/pcs`):** Switch and control multiple Windows workstations from a single Telegram chat.
- **Screen & Webcam Surveillance:** Instant desktop screenshots, short video clips with audio, and webcam photos.
- **Virtual Trackpad & Gestures:** Control cursor movement, left/right clicks, scrolling, and keyboard typing directly from your phone.
- **Remote Process & Terminal:** Execute PowerShell/CMD commands, inspect running processes, and kill frozen tasks.
- **Remote File Explorer & Clipboard:** Browse folders, download files to Telegram, upload files to PC, and sync clipboard text.
- **Silent Background Operation:** Runs invisibly in the background via Windows Task Scheduler with zero command windows or taskbar icons.

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Mazonia/pc-controller-bot.git
cd pc-controller-bot

# Set up virtual environment
python -m venv venv
.\venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Configure bot token and admin ID
copy .env.example .env
# Edit .env with BOT_TOKEN and ADMIN_IDS

# Start the agent
python bot.py
```

## Primary Telegram Commands
- `/pcs` - List registered PCs and switch active machine
- `/status` - View CPU, RAM, battery, uptime, and network diagnostics
- `/screen` - Capture high-resolution desktop screenshot
- `/webcam` - Capture webcam photo
- `/record [sec]` - Record screen video with audio
- `/mouse [dx] [dy]` - Move mouse cursor
- `/click [left|right]` - Trigger mouse click
- `/type [text]` - Type text onto active Windows window
- `/cmd [command]` - Execute shell command and view output
- `/lock` - Lock Windows workstation
- `/shutdown` - Power off PC remotely
